text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooogh! The Japan Dirt Derby's here at
last!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And the racecourse's packed to the
brim! Man,
there's nothin' better than
runnin' in a G1!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya read my mind! And trust me, you're in
for a
real treat!
choice_data_list: どデカい花火を見せてくれ！
どデカい花火を見せてね！

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which classic-year racer will take the
crown at the
Japan Dirt Derby? Don't go
anywhere, because
we're about to find
out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right... Time to get this festival goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know you... You're on Chief's team,
right?

text_block_list.name: Oi Racer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Good luck to us both.

text_block_list.name: Oi Racer
text_block_list.text: 'Cept, I'll be standin' on top in the end.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe, someone's ready for a scrap! I
guess
everyone's cravin' to knock me
down a peg.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You're on! I love a good fight!
